title: ChatBan.bannedBy from the Commit's sender: MembersChanged carries the committer
description: Decision mimid-1wgh.62 item 13, Mark 2026-11-19: a ChatBan mirrored from a ban another admin made names the owner's accountId as bannedBy, which is wrong. Event::MembersChanged gains the committer's user URI (from the Commit's sender leaf before the Commit; external commits: the joiner), kept in the journal (format change: old entries read as unknown committer). mimid-agent-jmap uses it for bannedBy (the committer's ChatContact id, or the accountId if it is the owner); unknown committer -> keep current behaviour and note it. Test: bob (admin) bans carol; alice's device mirrors the ChatBan with bannedBy = bob's ChatContact id.
